prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE product-grade landscape desktop web app screenshot, maximum supported landscape resolution, target 1672x941 (16:9). This is UI-hub.png for Our World, concept A Across the Table.
Reference roles: A1 locks Xiaoman's ORIGINAL identity and high-end anime CG art style; A2 locks exact neutral Cinnaglass floating UI; C1 ONLY inspires a rain-soaked lit-window architectural overview, do not copy its chibi proportions or its many residents.
SCREEN: 大厅, an overview of spaces with PEOPLE or GROUPS, never a room catalogue. A beautifully detailed cozy three-storey corner apartment facade nearly fills the central screen at night, rain outside, amber practical interior lights and rich indigo-blue rim/ambient lights, reflective paving, climbing greenery. Three clearly distinct large windows, with crisp enough characters to recognize:
Upper-left a big warmly lit window contains exactly ONE young adult Xiaoman seated half-body at her table facing outward toward viewer, glancing out softly, wearing headphones. Same chestnut shoulder-length hair, wispy bangs, small gold star hair clip, warm amber eyes, cream chunky-knit cardigan, white tee, gold necklace as A1. Mug on her table. Small understated frosted name tag directly UNDER that window: 小满.
Upper-right a broad warmly lit GROUP window with EXACTLY THREE adult friends seated around a board game table, mid-body hidden by table: Yuanyuan high ponytail + big white headphones + mustard sweater, Lao K male knit beanie + olive jacket, Qiqi female short silver bob + black turtleneck. Semi-realistic anime adults, not children/chibi. Under that window only: 周末桌游.
Lower-right a DARK unoccupied window, empty table and empty chairs, only ONE cat on sill, subdued cool light, no human silhouettes, no ghost partner. Below it: 室友们 and smaller 离线.
UI must be exactly same material/family as A2: neutral smoke-grey fine-grain frosted glass, soft backdrop blur, hairline pale rim, rounded corners, soft offwhite thin line icons/text, muted warm gold active state. Upper left separate small clock and cloud circular buttons. Left edge slim vertical five-icon rail home/chat/music/wrench/settings, home selected warm gold. Small heading 大厅 next to rail not huge. Top right anniversary card 在一起 1221 天. A small white desktop hand cursor over Xiaoman's window, no highlight outline. Adjacent to her window show one compact hover preview with two readable lines 小满 · 在听歌 and a warm gold button 进入. Keep the preview OFF her face, all labels clean Simplified Chinese. Limit UI coverage, architecture stays hero.
Rendering: match A1/A2 high-end 2D semi-realistic anime CG, fine clean linework, soft cel shading and painterly gradients, warm skin, intricate hair, cinematic bloom and depth separation; architectural setting as detailed as reference C1, natural evening exposure not excessive dark wash. No OS/browser branding, no logos, no watermarks, no explanatory marketing copy, no glowing rings/halos/outline markers anywhere around windows/objects. Do NOT add extra people in other windows. This overview is an intentional exception to close first-person table view. Deliver a single landscape image.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the FIRST reference image UI-hub-initial, retaining its exact 1672x941 landscape composition, architecture, people, fine anime CG finish and all existing CHINESE UI. A1 second reference preserves Xiaoman identity. There are two outdoor freestanding black chalkboard signs on the street: one at bottom-left of cafe entrance, and one to the right of the building. REMOVE ALL ENGLISH WORDS from both chalkboards and replace the lettering areas with simple small chalk drawings of a coffee cup and leafy sprig, no text. This is the only requested change. Preserve the three named windows, exact one Xiaoman, three friends, dark empty roommates window with cat, warm rain-night lighting, hover preview, all Cinnaglass UI positions and legible Chinese text unchanged. Do not add text or other objects; no other changes.

Use case: precise-object-edit. FIRST image is UI-rooms desktop screenshot to edit. Second A1 is identity/style reference. Preserve EXACT layout, ALL TEN room cards and ALL Chinese text, glyphs, checks, gold selection, labels, shelf, icons, buttons, nav, clock/cloud and anniversary. Correct ONLY the background focus and one low-contrast note. Apply visibly soft photographic defocus blur to the current large scene behind the entire room picker: the large Xiaoman face/hair/cardigan, table, lamp, city, and any reflections all gently but clearly out of focus, still recognizable with A1 identity, not erased or painted over. NO change to any thumbnail image (they must stay SHARP), and every UI panel, word, icon remains SHARP. Increase note 换房间会同时带上 TA to soft offwhite for legibility, same position. Keep landscape 1672x941. Do not add/remove rooms or characters, do not change materials or composition. Only background blur + note contrast.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE product-grade desktop full-width app screen named 回忆墙 for Our World Across the Table. Largest supported landscape, target 1672x941 (16:9). Reference A1 strictly locks Xiaoman's original identity and anime CG art, A2 locks exact Cinnaglass neutral frosted UI.
We are Ayu seated FIRST PERSON looking at Xiaoman across the table in the same cozy rainy night apartment as A1. Background gently blurred and dimmed so reading is effortless: recognisable solitary Xiaoman half body behind task window, lamp at left, blue rainy skyline at rear, record player at right. Very bottom edge includes viewer's own charcoal hoodie sleeves and hands holding cup, no full self avatar. No background human reflections.
A large centered FOCUSED TASK WINDOW occupying roughly 82 percent width and 80 percent height. ONE continuous rounded fine-grain neutral smoke gray frosted-glass OUTER shell with soft backdrop blur and thin pale rim. Header and footer part of the SAME shell, not stacked separate panels. Inside it ONE inset rounded OPAQUE WARM DARK TAUPE reading lining, completely opaque and comfortably contrasted, not transparent, not a parchment/wooden panel. Title upper-left 回忆墙; small line beneath 从暗房带回的光. Top right simple close x. No huge text.
Interior left ~72% is a beautiful polaroid photo wall grouped into TWO separated chronological months: 9月 and 8月. 9月 shows THREE original high-end anime photos (greenhouse seedling grown by two hands, Xiaoman across a cafe table, quiet rooftop stars), 8月 shows THREE more photos (seaside shells on table with viewer hands, Ayu with thin round glasses/black tousled hair across a train table, mugs by cabin fire). Slightly rotated white photo-paper frames and tiny realistic tape corners, orderly airy layout, sharp photo images, no stock IP. Small short labels below photos e.g. 第一片叶 / 雨天咖啡 / 一起看星星 / 海边拾贝 / 夜行列车 / 炉边热茶. Polaroid paper belongs only to PHOTO CONTENT. The task lining behind them stays warm dark taupe.
Interior right ~28% a SLIM diary timeline column on same opaque lining, separated with one fine divider, heading 我们的日记. Delicate vertical hairline with three gold point dates 9.25 / 9.18 / 8.30 and short readable one- or two-line Simplified Chinese entries: 小芽长高了 / 和你听了一场雨 / 把海风带回家. Discreet tiny icons of leaf / rain / shell. No long gibberish paragraphs, no sample lorem ipsum. This is a combined photo-and-timeline focused task; NOT an open book, no page turning, no huge drawer/sidebar.
Bottom-right of shell near footer: a small charming half-body corner Xiaoman avatar preview smiling at the memories, identical chestnut hair + star clip + amber eyes + gold necklace + cream cardigan. Only this explicit corner avatar besides the blurred background partner; miniature preview is not a second real person in the room. It must not obscure entries or photos. Small speech bubble 好喜欢这张. Bottom-left unobtrusive outlined action 添加回忆.
Outside shell left edge visible but dimmed same A2 five-icon navigation and top-left clock/cloud circles, top-right anniversary 在一起 1221 天 optional only if enough margin and no overlap.
Refined cinematic illustration, fine linework, cel shading and painterly gradients, warm practical lamp vs cool rainy ambient. The scene remains a quiet atmosphere, task CONTENT is reading focus. Pixel-polished alignment, spacious padding, legible short Simplified Chinese. No logos, branding, watermarks, diagram arrows, glowing rings/halos around objects, chibi, photoreal people, or IP resemblance. Produce a single complete screenshot with no device bezel.

Use case: precise-object-edit. First image is the UI-memories screenshot edit target. Second A1 locks Xiaoman's identity and anime style. Preserve exact composition and ALL SIX polaroids, month headings, window shape, neutral continuous Cinnaglass shell and opaque warm dark taupe interior, timeline date/headings, foreground viewer's charcoal hoodie hands/mug, small smiling corner Xiaoman, navigation and buttons. Two corrections ONLY:
1. Make the LARGE background seated Xiaoman's face, hair, sweater visibly softly out of focus along with the rest of the background behind the task window, so the window content has reading priority. The small corner-avatar and ALL polaroids must stay sharp and identical.
2. Remove the extra small paragraphs under each of the THREE diary headings in the right column. Keep only these short entries and existing dates: 9.25 小芽长高了 ; 9.18 和你听了一场雨 ; 8.30 把海风带回家. Leave clean warm dark taupe empty space where paragraphs were. No substitute text. Keep all other text unchanged and legible, including 回忆墙, 从暗房带回的光, 我们的日记, 9月, 8月, photo captions, 添加回忆 and 好喜欢这张. Do not alter opacity of the reading lining. No other changes. 1672x941 landscape.
